claims.claim: The requested names, rigid structure, dimensions, mass, and appearance are present.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf names the robot and sole link block, assigns mass 0.03 kg, and contains block_body plus stud_1_1 through stud_2_4. readings.json declares kind rigid, size_cm [6.4, 3.2, 2.4], a 0.064 x 0.032 x 0.019 m body and eight 0.010 x 0.010 x 0.005 m studs. All four renders show a single orange brick with cylindrical studs in two rows of four. probes/geometry.json confirms visual bounds [-0.032,-0.016,0] to [0.032,0.016,0.024] and one material.

claims.claim: Collision geometry adequately follows the solid body and all eight studs.
claims.evidence: readings.json collision_boxes and asset/model.urdf provide the full solid body with bottom z=0 and eight separate stud boxes spanning z=0.019 to 0.024 m. renders/iso.png and renders/top.png agree with their placement. The requested square stud collision boxes circumscribe the 10 mm cylindrical visuals (corner excess about 2.07 mm); no required cavity or grasp access is filled, and no visible part lacks collision coverage.

claims.claim: The body is accessible for a grasp from above with the specified gripper.
claims.evidence: readings.json block_body spans Y=-0.016 to 0.016 m: a 32 mm grasp width is below the 80 mm finger opening. Its 64 mm length accommodates 20 mm-wide fingers. Studs extend only to Y=+/-0.013 m, inside the body sides, so descending fingers outside Y=+/-0.016 m have clear access to the 19 mm-high side faces; confirmed by renders/iso.png and renders/front.png. This is a geometric accessibility check.

claims.claim: Joint range, attachment, and inter-link interference checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json joints is empty and asset/model.urdf contains one link and no joints.

claims.claim: Handle grasp-and-pull checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is empty.

claims.claim: Place-target settling checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no place targets; readings.json place_targets is empty.

claims.claim: The unfixed block settles and stays upright on the ground.
claims.evidence: probes/01_settle.py initializes Probe with fixed=False and pos=(0,0,0), using collision z_min=0. probes/01_settle.out shows identity orientation and unchanged reported position [0,0,0.01197] at cumulative frames 30, 150, and 300 (1, 5, and 10 seconds). Four ground contacts each carry 0.074 N, totaling about 0.296 N against the 0.03 kg weight of 0.294 N. The helper reports a 0.012 m initial link-position offset and correspondingly offset box bounds; stability is supported by the persistent ground contacts and constant upright pose, not those absolute helper bounds.
